newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Stet says SEAT spin off complete.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Stet says SEAT spin off complete.

text.p: Italy's telecoms holding group Stet said on Tuesday that the spin off of its yellow pages publisher SEAT was complete and the new company may be listed from January 2.
A statement said the spinoff would take effect on December 31 and shares in SEAT SpA could be put on the market two days later after approval by bourse regulator Consob.
Brokers Actinvest said on Monday that SEAT was a "buy" opportunity up to 730 lire a share.
The Milan broker has valued the company at little under three trillion lire, which values the ordinary shares at 612 lire each and savings shares at 397 lire a share.

STET said last month it intended to issue 3.834 million ordinary shares and 1.447 million savings shares of nominal values of 50 lire to be allocated to STET shareholders in the ratio of one SEAT share for every STET share held.
